in_sanskrit.name: जयसूक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विजयी (vijayi) - victorious sूक्षम् (suksham) - subtle, delicate, refined

in_marathi.name: Jaysukh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory over ignorance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaysukh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaya (Victory) + Sukha (Happiness, Pleasure) Jaysukh represents the victory of knowledge and wisdom over ignorance and suffering.

in_bengali.name: Jaysukh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Victory over ignorance
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jaysukh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jaya (Victory) + Sukha (Happiness, Pleasure) Jaysukh represents the victory of knowledge and wisdom over ignorance and suffering.
